rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an individual spoken remark or casual comment, especially something someone says in passing.

example.english: They made a remark just now that made everyone laugh.
example.traditional: 佢頭先講咗一句說話，令大家都笑咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 tau4 sin1 gong2 zo2 jat1 geoi3 syut3 waa6 ling6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 siu3 zo2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for stating or saying an observation.

example.english: I want to remark that today's wind is really strong.
example.traditional: 我想話，今日啲風真係大。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 waa6 gam1 jat6 di1 fung1 zan1 hai6 daai6

rows.note: Use this when the remark explicitly points out or draws attention to an observed fact, especially in more formal speech or writing.

example.english: The report goes on to remark that this plan is risky.
example.traditional: 份報告指出，呢個計劃有風險。
example.jyutping: fan6 bou3 gou3 zi2 ceot1 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 fung1 him2

rows.note: Use this for the fact or act of mentioning something, especially in formal or written contexts rather than for a conversational comment.

example.english: The report makes a remark about this issue.
example.traditional: 份報告入面提及咗呢個問題。
example.jyutping: fan6 bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 tai4 kap6 zo2 ni1 go3 man6 tai4
